items.summary: Concreting work on the fourth tier of the reactor building's inner containment at unit 1 of Egypt's El Dabaa nuclear power plant has been completed, the Nuclear Power Plants Authority announced.

items.title: Latest MAST Upgrade experiments achieve milestones
items.summary: The United Kingdom Atomic Energy Authority's flagship fusion machine, MAST Upgrade, has completed its fifth round of experiments, during which it achieved the highest plasma pressure it has ever attained while overcoming plasma instability issues considered essential prerequisites for commercial fusion power.
